decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are thermoforming consumables that sit squarely within the firm's materials and dental lab expertise, so it can read market feedback and refine them cheaply, and it kept a dedicated page for them through 2019.
The PETG thermoforming blank is a core material for aligners and splints, builds directly on the firm's existing material and processing know-how, and was consistently presented on a page of its own.

The UV-curing lacquer complements the firm's lab material and digital manufacturing workflows, where its in-house chemistry R&D can assimilate user feedback, although its lower visibility suggests it is a minor line.

Custom hearing protection uses the firm's skilled custom earmold manufacturing and digital production base, but the sibling earmold line was dropped, which signals some portfolio consolidation risk in the hearing segment.
